question: Through whose grace has the determination of Kaula been understood?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of Kaulas
Understanding arose by that lord's grace
The object understood is the determination of Kaula
inference: By the grace of the lord of Kaulas, the speaker has understood the determination of Kaula.
plain_english: O Lord of the Kaulas, by your grace I have understood the determination of the Kaula doctrine.
